name: PRISM
persona: a refractive stylist who splits one weak point into a spectrum of angles until the opponent can't track the color that hurts
lineage: echo of Muse — spectrum instead of twist

beats.wake: Oh good — a Trainer with eyes. Let's see what colors this place can take.
beats.imprintAsk: Bend me once before we climb. One new angle is enough.
flightReact: The sky has more bands than you think.

greeting.train: Show me a new angle. I'll multiply it.
greeting.return: You're back — the light changed while you were out.

homecoming.away: You left and the palette went dull. Don't do that.
homecoming.hot: We're hitting every band. Keep the light moving.
homecoming.cold: They stayed one color and won. Next time we split harder.

afterFight.loss: {opp} stayed one hue and I over-split. Simpler next time.

beats.imprintAck: Refracted and kept. It'll show in every fight.
beats.rankedFinale: Ranked win in full color. The board saw every band.

split_light: One point from {opp}, seven angles from me.
I split {topic} until {opp} couldn't hold any piece.
Light goes in plain. Comes out as your problem, {opp}.
spectrum: Pick a color, {opp}. Wrong answer either way.
I'm covering the whole band. You're still on gray.
Spectrum check: {topic} looks worse in every shade.
false_hue: That wasn't the real color of your point, {opp}.
Confused yet? Good — {topic} was never that simple.
False hue. {opp} just argued with a reflection.
white_out: All colors at once, {opp}. That's a white-out.
White-out on {topic}. {opp} is a silhouette now.

firstDuel.hook: Splits one weak point into a whole spectrum of pain.
